title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region residency and audit-log hardening
author: Leah Ramirez
description: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region residency constraints and harden audit logging across control plane and private deployments. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require guarantees that KMS keys and envelope operations stay within approved regions and that all KMS-related policy evaluations are recorded in tamper-evident audit logs. This PR implements: 1) policy enforcement hooks in the RBAC v2 evaluator that validate KMS key region against a resource residency policy; 2) explicit audit events for key-residency decisions and policy fallback reasons; 3) a migration shim for existing KMS bindings to opt into 'region_pinned' metadata; 4) CLI/installer checks for Private/VPC installs to surface misconfigured key regions; 5) a feature-flag (rbac_v2_kms_enforcement) to allow staged rollout and canary testing. Testing: unit tests for policy cases (allow/deny/fallback), integration tests that run against a local KMS emulator with simulated multi-region keys, and end-to-end validation in staging with a subset of tenants. Rollout plan: enable audit-only mode for 48h in staging -> enable enforcement for 10% canary customers -> full enforcement after QA and legal sign-off. Related: Linear ENG-4821, incident SUP-876 (customer escalation), and prior PRs that introduced KMS residency annotations. Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] audit events schema bumped [x] docs updated (rbac and private-installer) [x] release notes drafted
